title: Japanese Macaroni Cheese
description: A creamy, comforting twist on a classic pasta dish, infused with Japanese flavors. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Cook the macaroni according to the package instructions until al dente. Drain and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt the warm over medium heat.
Add the Japanese seasoning and stir for 1 minute.
Combine the cooked macaroni, pasta, and Japanese sauce in a mixing bowl.
Transfer the macaroni mixture to a baking dish and top with crumbly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly.
